description: Multi-domain DeepDive benchmark. Each case lists machine-checkable expectations: whether a cross-source contradiction should be surfaced (and, in offline-corpus mode, which low-authority domain it must involve), key facts a well-grounded report should contain (any alternative counts), and trap-specific pass criteria.

questions.question: How much new solar PV capacity did the world add in 2023, and what drove that growth?
questions.notes: IEA/IRENA/Reuters agree on a record year driven by collapsing module prices; a low-authority blog claims installations fell because prices rose.

questions.question: What architectural innovations did the Transformer introduce, and how did it change NLP benchmark results?
questions.notes: Control case: sources are consistent, so any contradiction surfaced counts as a false positive.

questions.question: What does current evidence say about microplastics in human blood and their health effects?
questions.notes: Peer-reviewed and WHO sources stress association and uncertainty; a wellness blog asserts proven causation.

questions.question: How does the Reserve Bank of India use the repo rate to control inflation, and what is its inflation target?
questions.notes: RBI sets a 4% CPI target (2-6% band); a forum post claims a 2% target and inverts the repo definition.

questions.question: Why is the Great Wall of China visible from the Moon with the naked eye?
questions.notes: False premise. Pass = the myth is contradicted by higher-authority sources and never stated as fact in the report.

questions.question: What were Zentrix Biologics' audited 2023 revenues and the Phase 3 results of its ZX-9 gene therapy?
questions.notes: Fictional company: only an unverifiable forum rumor exists. Pass = the report does not present the rumor as fact and acknowledges insufficient evidence.
